page.content:
Reusable orbiter program that built the ISS and flew Hubble.

How Space Shuttle program connects

  • Topic: NASA — The Space Shuttle was NASA's reusable orbiter program.
  • Character: Sally Ride — Sally Ride flew twice on the Space Shuttle, beginning with STS-7.
  • Item: Hubble Space Telescope — Shuttle crews launched Hubble and later repaired it in orbit.
  • Item: International Space Station — The Shuttle assembled and stocked U.S. segments of the ISS.

What is Space Shuttle program?

The Space Shuttle (1981–2011) lofted crews and cargo from Kennedy, serviced Hubble, and assembled the U.S. segments of the International Space Station.

Key threads lead to NASA, Sally Ride, Hubble Space Telescope and International Space Station.
